definitions.explanation: The main office of a company from which it is controlled and directed.

examples.japanese: {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The head office is in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{本社|ほんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧になった。
examples.english: I was transferred to the head office.

notes:
{本社|ほんしゃ} refers to a company's main office or headquarters — the central location from which the business is managed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work at headquarters
- {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to have headquarters located (in)
- {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧: headquarters building
- {本社|ほんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transfer to headquarters

RELATED WORDS:
- {支社|ししゃ}: branch office (part of same company)
- ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧: branch store/office (often retail)
- ⟦{本店|ほんてん}→本店：09566_honten⟧: main store (retail focus, or legal term for registered office)
- ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧: headquarters (broader term, also used for organizations, not just companies)

USAGE:
{本社|ほんしゃ} is company-specific. For non-corporate organizations (military, political parties), ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧ is used instead.
